title: Projected Multi-Head Attention in PyTorch
prompt:
Implement `MHA(n_heads, dim)` with `forward(x, mask=None) -> output` using PyTorch scaled dot-product self-attention.

Input `x` has shape `(B, T, dim)`, and the output must have the same shape. `mask` is either None or a boolean tensor of shape `(T, T)`: True means blocked and False means allowed. Apply it to the attention scores before softmax. You may assume every query row has at least one unmasked key.

example.input: model = MHA(2, 8); x = torch.randn(2, 3, 8); out = model(x, torch.ones(3, 3, dtype=torch.bool).triu(diagonal=1))
example.reasoning: Two heads each use four features, and the caller-supplied triangular mask blocks future keys.
